interface_gate: Fixed eligibility gate, not learned: full has gradients and target-layer access; no_grad_logits supports batched perturbed inputs and logits plus the frozen probability activation. A probability-only API is not certified.
tie_rule: First method in fixed eligible order for training; all methods within tolerance of the optimum count as oracle hits in evaluation.
baseline: Training-only modal oracle label per objective and interface, with fixed-order ties; additional training-only mean rank-regret minimizer per objective and interface.
limits: Chosen before the first fit; no test-set tuning. Same six known task/model combinations, fixed budgets/weights/targets, conditioned on model correctness. No new GPU attribution. Shared-wrapper timing is exploratory. CI excludes model-training and new-task uncertainty.
